subject: Procurement kickoff — cross-team availability & timezone heatmap (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff — cross-team availability & timezone heatmap (Acme Health)

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week. To get the vendor onboarding process started cleanly, we want to lock a 60–75 minute procurement kickoff that includes:

- Procurement (your team) to confirm contract & SLAs
- Engineering (your platform/infra leads) to cover network, data residency, and SSO
- InfoSec to go over SOC2/controls and evidence requests
- Redwood AE + SE to present rollout plan, timelines, and next steps

We know coordinating across timezones is a pain, so I built a quick availability heatmap and a shared matrix where everyone can mark times that work. Can you:

1) Add the primary technical contact + security contact to the sheet (link below)
2) Pick up to three preferred kickoff slots next week (we'll prioritize overlap)

Proposed slots (PST / EDT):
- Tue Aug 25: 09:30–10:45 PT (12:30–13:45 ET)
- Tue Aug 25: 15:00–16:15 PT (18:00–19:15 ET)
- Wed Aug 26: 08:00–09:15 PT (11:00–12:15 ET)

Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcdHeatmapExample (I've pre-filled a heatmap view and an "availability_matrix.xlsx" stub attached)

Attachments: [availability_heatmap.png (png, 38KB)], [availability_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 14KB)]

If those windows don't work, tell us a couple of windows that do and we'll cascade availability to the rest of the cross-functional group.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on calendar.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff — cross-team availability & timezone heatmap (Acme Health)

Diego — quick internal note before we sync with Acme:

- Karthik can take the SE slot for the kickoff and will demo the dedicated/private options + expected throughput for their baseline.
- I will cover procurement/PS contracting questions and collect the list of required RFP items.
- Can you add a brief agenda (30/25/10) for timeboxing (overview / technical deep-dive / next steps)?

I'll also prepare a short checklist of the SOC2 artifacts we often surface during kickoff so that when Rajiv (security) joins we can hand that list over. For scheduling: if Acme prefers an early slot, we can push the demo to the second half so InfoSec gets the first 30.

Attaching a draft agenda and a compact availability grid to propose to Acme.

Attachments: [procurement_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (pdf, 22KB)]

Thanks — Monica

From: Alicia Ramos <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jae Kim <eng-lead@acmehealth.com>, Rajiv Mehta <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff — cross-team availability & timezone heatmap (Acme Health)

Hi Diego / Monica / Karthik —

Thanks for the proposed slots and for building the heatmap. I invited Jae (engineering lead) and Rajiv (head of InfoSec) to join the thread — they should be able to mark availability directly in the sheet.

Preliminary notes from our side:
- Our procurement team prefers Tue Aug 25 in the earlier window, but Rajiv asked that security is on the front half of the call.
- Jae would prefer anything between 09:00–13:00 ET.
- We also need a brief list of what evidence you will present (SOC2, data retention policy, encryption at rest/in transit). Can you attach or list those?

I've updated the sheet with our team's preferred slots and added two alternative slots Sept 1 in case Aug 25 fills up.

Preferred (we marked):
- Tue Aug 25: 12:30–13:45 ET (your first proposed slot) — marked as preferred
- Wed Aug 26: 11:00–12:15 ET — backup

If you confirm the Tue 12:30 ET slot, I’ll put a tentative hold on our calendar and loop in procurement legal for the contractual checklist.

Best —
Alicia Ramos
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com

Perfect — Tue Aug 25 at 12:30 ET works for our team. I’ve scheduled a 75-minute block and sent a calendar invite (tentative until accept).

Agenda (high level):
- 12:30–12:40 ET: Introductions & objectives (Diego / Alicia)
- 12:40–13:10 ET: Technical deep-dive (Karthik) — network, SSO, data residency, expected QPS
- 13:10–13:30 ET: Security & evidence checklist (Monica / Rajiv)
- 13:30–13:45 ET: Contracting items & next steps (Monica)

Attachments: procurement_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + artifact list).
Next steps for attendees: please accept the invite and add any critical items to the shared sheet. We’ll circulate minutes and action items within 24 hours of the call.

Doc links: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/kickoff-acme-24819
HubSpot deal: deal_24819

Thanks everyone — see you on Tue.

— Diego
